readiness.jsonld_change_note: THE STRUCTURE CHANGED TODAY AND IT IS WORTH KNOWING. Yesterday the homepage carried Organization + LocalBusiness. Today it carries LocalBusiness + WebSite. The standalone Organization block is gone, but the organisation entity has NOT been lost: the LocalBusiness block now carries @id 'https://dxliving.com/#organization', declares parentOrganization FeelDX, and adds a sameAs array pointing at four owned profiles (Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube). The new WebSite block references that same @id as its publisher. Because schema.org LocalBusiness is a subtype of Organization, both signals still pass, and the sameAs additions are a genuine improvement for entity disambiguation by AI systems. Recorded as a change, not as a regression. / CAU TRUC DOI HOM NAY VA CAN BIET. Hom qua trang chu mang Organization + LocalBusiness. Hom nay mang LocalBusiness + WebSite. Khoi Organization doc lap da mat, nhung thuc the to chuc thi KHONG mat: khoi LocalBusiness nay mang @id 'https://dxliving.com/#organization', khai bao parentOrganization la FeelDX, va them mang sameAs tro toi bon kenh so huu (Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube). Khoi WebSite moi tro toi dung @id do lam publisher. Vi LocalBusiness trong schema.org la kieu con cua Organization, ca hai tin hieu van dat, va phan sameAs them vao la cai tien that cho viec cac he thong AI phan biet thuc the. Ghi nhan la thay doi, khong phai thut lui.
